definitions: Do not cause problems or act unethically in a place where you derive your livelihood or support.
Avoid creating difficulties or making a mess in your own environment or among people you depend on.
examples: He learned the hard way not to shit where he eats after getting fired.
It's a bad idea to date your coworker; you don't shit where you eat.
Don't complain about your boss to clients; you don't shit where you eat.
lemma: not to shit where one eats
synonyms: don't bite the hand that feeds you
